name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Gaza strikes 20–21 Nov; Houthi fire at Riyadh
summary: Israeli fire killed four in Gaza on 21 Nov, civil defence says; Saudi coalition intercepted 3 Houthi missiles
state: Gaza's civil defence said Israeli fire killed four people on 21 Nov, three in a drone strike on a food-aid vehicle in Gaza City; the Israeli military said it hit militants, and four were killed near Bureij on 20 Nov (RTE). The health ministry says more than 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted three Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh early on 21 Nov (Xinhua). Israel struck Lebanon's Beqaa on 20 Nov. Hostilities on several fronts keep the Alert.
for_you: Travel risk in Israel, Gaza, Lebanon, Yemen and parts of Saudi Arabia remains high. Anyone with plans in the region can follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Alert: multi-front hostilities — Gaza strikes, Israeli strike in Lebanon (20 Nov), Houthi missiles at Riyadh (21 Nov)
